questions.prompt: Which service is the fully managed (PaaS) way to host a web app or API?
questions.explanation: App Service is PaaS web hosting: you deploy code or a container and Azure runs, patches, and scales the platform for you.

questions.prompt: Which statements about Azure compute are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: A Virtual Machine (IaaS) gives the most control but you maintain the OS
Azure Functions can scale to zero and bill per execution
AKS is managed Kubernetes for complex orchestration
App Service requires you to patch the operating system yourself

questions.explanation: VMs give control with OS upkeep; Functions scale to zero and bill per run; AKS is managed Kubernetes. App Service is PaaS — Azure patches the OS, not you.

questions.prompt: The serverless, event-driven Azure compute service that runs small pieces of code is Azure ____.
questions.explanation: Azure Functions runs event-driven code (HTTP, timer, queue, blob triggers) and, on the Consumption plan, scales to zero and bills per execution.

questions.prompt: Order these from the MOST infrastructure you manage to the LEAST.
questions.explanation: A VM (IaaS) has you manage the OS and up; App Service (PaaS) manages the platform; Functions (serverless) has you supply only code.

questions.prompt: Match each compute service to its description.

pairs.right: IaaS computer where you manage the OS
Managed hosting for web apps and APIs

questions.explanation: VM = IaaS; App Service = PaaS web hosting; Functions = serverless; AKS = managed Kubernetes.
